Board Adjustment: a percentage of positive Base Points becomes Board Points
Example for a score of 25 in a 4-player game with a 0.15 factor:
Base Points = (Total All Scores - Your Score × 4) × Game Point Factor
Negative results keep their full Base Points
Final Points = Base Points - Board Adjustment Points
Positive results contribute the configured percentage to Board Points
